protocol.description: This protocol defines extensions to the Wayland core protocol to support terminal compositing, cell-buffer rendering, cursor-anchored overlays, remote SSH operation without file-descriptor passing, structured terminal input, theme synchronization, and legacy PTY bridging.

interface.name: zterm_compositor_v1
interface.description: The global factory interface for creating terminal-specific surface roles, cursor-anchored positioners, and buffer factories.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the server that the client will not use this factory further. Existing objects created through this interface remain unaffected.

request.name: get_grid_surface

description.summary: assign the grid surface role to a wl_surface

request.description:
Assigns the 2D character grid surface role to an existing wl_surface. Grid surfaces represent addressable character cell matrices such as terminal panes, floating dialogs, menus, and TUI canvases.
A wl_surface must only be assigned one role.

request.name: get_stream_surface

description.summary: assign the stream surface role to a wl_surface

request.description: Assigns the structured append-only text/log stream role to a wl_surface. Stream surfaces represent continuous log outputs with infinite scrollback and zero coordinate-based cursor jumping.

request.name: get_cursor_anchor
request.description: Creates a positioner that anchors a child surface (e.g. an autocomplete menu or hover card) relative to the active text cursor in a target surface.

arg.name: target_surface
arg.summary: the surface whose cursor is followed

interface.name: zterm_buffer_factory_v1

description.summary: factory for stream-safe and SSH-forwarded cell buffers

interface.description: Creates wl_buffer instances backed by character cell matrices without requiring file-descriptor passing (SCM_RIGHTS), enabling transparent OpenSSH socket forwarding (ssh -R) on both macOS and Linux.

enum.name: cell_format
enum.description: Defines the ABI format of cell memory in the buffer.

entry.name: compact_v1
entry.summary: 8 bytes per cell: u32 codepoint, u8 fg, u8 bg, u16 flags

entry.name: rich_v1
entry.summary: 32 bytes per cell: u32 codepoint, u32 fg_rgba, u32 bg_rgba, u32 ul_rgba, u32 hyperlink_id, u32 flags, u8 width

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the factory. Existing buffers remain valid until destroyed.

request.name: create_cell_buffer
request.description: Allocates a wl_buffer of the specified dimensions. The client populates the buffer data using upload_cells before attaching and committing to a surface.

request.name: upload_cells

description.summary: upload a chunk of cell binary data

request.description: Appends or writes a chunk of row-major cell data at byte offset within the buffer. Chunk sizes MUST NOT exceed 3072 bytes per request to stay safely within the Wayland wire protocol message limit (WL_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE = 4096).

interface.name: zterm_grid_surface_v1
interface.description: Represents a 2D character cell canvas. The client attaches cell wl_buffers created via standard wl_shm to the underlying wl_surface, damages cell regions, and commits atomically.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the grid surface role and unmaps it from the compositor scene.

request.name: set_title
request.description: Sets the user-visible title or pane label for this surface.

request.name: set_scrollback_max_lines
request.description: Specifies the maximum scrollback lines maintained for this surface. A value of 0 disables scrollback history.

request.name: clear_scrollback
request.description: Clears existing scrollback lines without disturbing active grid contents.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: Signals to the compositor that the client has processed the configure event with the specified serial.

request.name: set_position
request.description: Sets the top-left (col, row) offset of this grid surface on the compositor canvas.

event.name: configure
event.description: Informs the client of the current grid dimensions in character cells and the physical pixel dimensions of a single character cell.

arg.name: cell_width_px
arg.summary: physical pixel width of one cell

arg.name: cell_height_px
arg.summary: physical pixel height of one cell

event.name: cursor_position
event.description: Emitted when the surface's active text cursor position moves. Useful for clients rendering cursor-relative overlays or synchronizing state.

event.name: close
event.description: Emitted when the user or compositor requests that this surface be closed.

interface.name: zterm_stream_surface_v1
interface.description: Represents a pure text or log stream surface with dedicated infinite scrollback and search. Applications append text sequentially without handling 2D cursor positions.

enum.name: style_flags
enum.description: Bitmask flags controlling text decoration and attributes.

entry.name: fg_palette
entry.summary: treat fg as ANSI 16-color palette index

entry.name: bg_palette
entry.summary: treat bg as ANSI 16-color palette index

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the stream surface.

request.name: append_text
request.description: Appends UTF-8 text to the end of the stream with default styling.

request.name: append_styled_text

description.summary: append text with explicit styling without ANSI escapes

request.description: Appends UTF-8 text to the end of the stream with explicit colors and style attributes. Colors are packed 32-bit RGBA (0xRRGGBBAA) unless fg_palette / bg_palette flags are specified, in which case the lowest 8 bits specify an ANSI 16-color palette index (0-15).

arg.name: fg
arg.summary: packed 32-bit RGBA foreground color or palette index

arg.name: bg
arg.summary: packed 32-bit RGBA background color or palette index

request.name: clear
request.description: Clears all scrollback and active contents in the stream surface.

event.name: configure
event.description: Notifies the client of the current visible column width and row height.

interface.name: zterm_cursor_anchor_v1

description.summary: anchors an overlay surface to a target text cursor

interface.description: Positions a child overlay surface (such as an autocomplete popup, inline lint tooltip, or hover card) relative to the active text cursor of a target surface.

entry.name: below_start
entry.summary: below cursor, aligned to cursor start

entry.name: above_start
entry.summary: above cursor, aligned to cursor start

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the anchor positioner.

request.name: set_placement
request.description: Specifies the preferred orientation of the overlay relative to the cursor.

request.name: set_offset
request.description: Specifies fine-tuning offsets in character cell units.

interface.name: zterm_keyboard_v1
interface.description: Extends or complements wl_keyboard by delivering resolved keys and UTF-8 payloads directly to CLI/TUI applications without requiring client-side xkbcommon libraries over remote SSH connections.

request.name: release
request.description: Releases the terminal keyboard listener.

event.name: key

description.summary: keyboard event with resolved key name and UTF-8 text

event.description:
Emitted when a key is pressed, repeated, or released.
The 'key_name' argument provides a normalized symbol (e.g., 'Enter', 'Escape', 'Tab', 'ArrowUp', 'F1', 'PageDown', 'BackSpace').
The 'utf8_text' argument contains printable character text if applicable.

interface.name: zterm_theme_manager_v1

description.summary: dynamic theme and color palette manager

interface.description: Allows clients to discover the active terminal color theme, dark/light mode, standard 16 ANSI colors, and semantic UI tokens. Emits events when the user switches themes.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the theme manager interface.

request.name: get_theme
request.description: Requests the compositor to immediately emit the current theme event.

event.name: theme
event.description: Broadcasts the active color scheme, background/foreground, and ANSI palette. Colors are packed 32-bit RGBA (0xRRGGBBAA).

arg.name: is_dark
arg.summary: 1 for dark mode, 0 for light mode

arg.name: ansi_palette
arg.summary: 16 x 32-bit RGBA packed array representing ANSI 0-15

interface.name: zterm_property_manager_v1

description.summary: session properties, feature flags, and getters/setters

interface.description: Provides structured out-of-band getters, setters, and change subscriptions for terminal properties, window state, desktop notifications, and security feature flags (replacing in-band OSC escape sequences).

entry.name: permission_denied
entry.summary: action prohibited by user security policy

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the property manager interface.

request.name: get_property
request.description: Asynchronously queries the value of a property key (e.g. 'window.title', 'a11y.screen_reader_active', 'features.system_notifications').

request.name: set_property
request.description: Mutates a writable property (e.g. 'window.title', 'window.subtitle').

request.name: watch_property
request.description: Subscribes to asynchronous change notifications whenever the specified property key changes value.

request.name: unwatch_property
request.description: Cancels subscription for the specified property key.

request.name: system_notify
request.description: Posts a desktop notification via the compositor.

event.name: property_value

description.summary: property value response or change notification

event.description: Emitted in response to get_property, or when a watched property mutates.

event.name: error
event.description: Emitted when a get_property or set_property fails.

interface.name: zterm_xpty_v1

description.summary: legacy VT100 / PTY bridge factory ('xpty', analogous to Xwayland)

interface.description: Allows the terminal compositor or helper processes to wrap legacy VT processes (bash, zsh, vim, htop) into an isolated grid surface backed by an existing slave PTY descriptor.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the xpty bridge factory.

request.name: attach_pty

description.summary: attach a slave PTY to a grid surface

request.description: Attaches a slave PTY file descriptor to an existing grid surface. The xpty bridge parses the PTY stream in complete isolation, clamping all escapes to the surface bounds and emitting cell buffer commits.
